verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the docs page saying Supabase offers several ways to connect to its Postgres database from frontend, persistent backend, or serverless code. That implies a standard Postgres connection an ORM could use, but nothing in the pack names Prisma, Drizzle, Django or Rails, or shows framework-specific guides. Missing for 10: documented Prisma/Drizzle/Django/Rails integration guides, evidence of out-of-the-box ORM compatibility (e.g. pooler/migration caveats), hands-on or independent corroboration.
